title: Ukraine: Marine drone explodes in Romanian port

Russia reports drone strike at Zaporizhzhia nuclear power station At least three workers at the Russia-controlled Zaporizhzhia nuclear power station were injured by a drone strike on Friday, Russia's nuclear energy corporation Rosatom said. Rosatom head Alexei Likachev said Ukraine had carried out a "calculated" strike on Russian engineers working at the plant. The incident took place at the start of an International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA)-brokered ceasefire around the plant in order to restore a power line, Rosatom said. There was no immediate comment from Ukraine. The IAEA's Director General Rafael Grossi on X called for maximum military restraint and full adherence to the ceasefire. The Zaporizhzhia plant does not generate electricity, but requires power and maintenance to ensure that nuclear fuel does not overheat. The plant was seized by Russian troops in the first weeks of the war, and Russia currently occupies some 75% of Zaporizhzhia oblast, while claiming to have annexed the entire territory. Both Russia and Ukraine accuse one another of undertaking military actions near the plant to compromise nuclear safety. Last week, Russia said a Ukrainian kamikaze combat drone struck the turbine hall building, causing no serious damage. Ukraine's military denied attacking the site, calling the claims "propaganda." Zelenskyy says Putin snub shows Moscow has no interest in ending war Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said Vladimir Putin's rejection of face-to-face talks was a clear sign that Russia does not want to end its war on Ukraine. "Unfortunately, the Russian side is once again choosing war," Zelenskyy said in his nightly video address, adding that Putin's response was "weak." Zelenskyy published an open letter to Russian President Putin on Thursday asking for face-to-face talks on ending the war in Ukraine, On Friday, Putin said there was "no point" in meeting Zelenskyy unless a peace deal including Russia's demands was on the table. These include handing over the eastern Donbas region to Russia, which Zelenskyy has said would amount to capitulation.
